excerpt: This white paper provides a comprehensive review of our present understanding of experimental neutrino anomalies that remain unresolved, charting the progress achieved over the last decade at the experimental and phenomenological level.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); M. A. Acero, C. A. Arguelles, M. Hostert et al. (172 authors)
title: White Paper on Light Sterile Neutrino Searches and Related Phenomenology
